title: Turnover package and validation documents | Aquemi
meta: Every document delivered with our polypropylene Purified Water package, by stage, under GMP or not: URS matrix, P&IDs, material certificates, test protocols, site safety information. Request a specimen package.
eyebrow: DOCUMENTATION · EU GMP ANNEX 15 · GUI-0029 · GAMP 5
headline: Every document your auditor asks for
lead: We write each document as we design, build and test your polypropylene Purified Water package. Each user requirement specification (URS) line traces to its proving document. Device makers validate processes with them (ISO 13485:2016, 7.5.6).

blocks.h: The turnover package, section by section
blocks.intro: Good manufacturing practice (GMP) closes testing with installation, operational and performance qualification (IQ, OQ, PQ). Not under GMP? The same stages apply, with commissioning and an acceptance test against your specification in place of qualification.

items.q: Can we see real documents before we order?
items.a: Yes. We send an Aquemi-written [specimen package]: the package index, protocol contents and record formats, shared [openly or under NDA]. Audit our quality system to see them in use.

items.q: Do you check third-party certificates, or just forward them?
items.a: We check them: markings and lot numbers against the certificate at receipt. Certificates reach you as the issuer sent them, never retyped. If you make products for clients, their auditors see the same records.

items.q: When do we see the protocols?
items.a: [protocol issue before FAT, weeks] before testing, the factory acceptance test (FAT) protocol reaches your quality unit for approval. Installation and operational qualification (IQ, OQ) protocols follow. They cite the FAT results your quality unit agreed to reuse (EU good manufacturing practice Annex 15, 3.6; GUI-0029, 8.1).
